title: Agents return malformed and unsupported output
demonstrates: An agent returns malformed or unsupported output
description: The analyst assigns a task to an agent that does not exist ("deploy_bot"); the schema validator rejects the unsupported value and re-prompts. The architect returns prose with a truncated JSON object; the parser rejects it and re-prompts. Both recover within the repair budget, and nothing invalid ever reaches the workspace.
